technique_name: Develop a strategy for improving user engagement with an online product.
description: A successful strategy for improving user engagement should include components such as personalization, gamification, content curation, improved user interface, and data analysis. Personalization involves adapting content to the user’s interests and preferences, which can help them feel connected to the product.
